integrity: A complete nine-difference structural proof and two separately implemented exhaustive checkers were reconstructed and run. All 65536 labelled subsets were checked. No external independent audit claimed.
limitations: Exact for the single labelled Shrikhande graph, not for arbitrary strongly regular graphs; literature coverage is incomplete and historical priority is not certified.
title: Triangles and cyclic lines are exactly the failed power-dominating placements in the Shrikhande graph
